market_context: The Nasdaq-100 rose 1.17% to 29,529.34 (QQQ +1.21% to $718.36) as tech staged an oversold bounce after last week's AI/debt selloff; memory and storage led while Amazon's Morgan Stanley top-pick call and a Palantir federal-cloud partnership helped lift megacap and software names ahead of Meta/Tesla earnings.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-10-19 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-05 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-05 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.
